name: synapse-workspace
description: Synapse: an IDE where several AI agents work in one workspace, directed from one screen.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core packages/client packages/mock-agent packages/cli && npm run build -w extensions/synapse-collab
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/protocol packages/core packages/client packages/mock-agent packages/cli && rm -rf extensions/synapse-collab/dist
